title: VINTAGE BAR UNIT ON CASTORS H-...
reason: Well-made fitted retro drinks cabinet, under-described by the title; no maker's mark found so value depends on retro demand.
findings: Small portable drinks cabinet on four brass ball castors, in a golden-brown veneered timber with rounded corners, chrome side carry handles and a barrel lock with a chrome star escutcheon (key tied on with a tag). Two-part lift-up lid and a fall front on chrome stays, both lined with orange-tan woodgrain laminate. Inside is a fitted timber rack with round holes for bottles and square recesses for glasses, brass hinges, and bare unpolished timber. All four photos viewed (front open, interior from above, two closed views): no maker's label, stamp, retailer plate or date is visible anywhere. The tags are handwritten auction tags only (read as numbers, not a maker). Style points to the 1950s to 60s, which fits 'vintage'. Size claim (H-54 L-67 D-46 cm) cannot be checked. Value rests on retro demand rather than a maker.
condition: Veneer and laminate look sound with minor surface marks and light wear on the lid edges. Interior racks are plain with some staining on the floor. Lock operation not shown. No glasses or other fittings included.
rescore_note: Well made fitted portable cocktail cabinet, about 1950s to 60s, sound with a neat fall-front and bottle rack interior and real retro appeal, but no maker's mark in any of the four photos, so mid band on style alone. No new price comps checked (search limit reached).
